requirements: one continuous stateful stream per native rate on representative physical hardware
record architecture, generator identity and one stable executable identity
all required deterministic mixed-content segments and continuation hashes
exact source, processed and committed frame counts; clean terminal status
no nonfinite values, envelope crossings or guard-bound violations
DSD64: all complete 28-bit windows contain 4..24 ones
DSD128 and DSD256: record windows, runs and state extrema without imposing DSD64 population rule
P11 requalifies every newly introduced runtime ISA/kernel family

independent_corpus.source_identity: source/release/provenance and SHA-256 of each independent excerpt
requirements: real independent recordings, not internally generated synthetic stimuli
route both DSD-origin preserve-reference remodulation and ordinary PCM mastering through the candidate composite
admitted renders have exact per-channel frames and a verified complete bit-window count
DSD64 admitted output has no 28-bit excursion outside 4..24 ones; higher-rate values are diagnostic
no silent gain correction: explicit overload rejection with nonzero status and optional recorded gain retry
compare source/output RMS and peak level with the appropriate reference scale, not the same scale for both domains
no positive statement about unmeasured real-corpus spectral or state extrema
independent_corpus.note: The sustained 30-minute-per-rate synthetic qualification and frozen analysis-v1 suite are separate gates; do not impose a second arbitrary 30-minute requirement on external excerpts or treat short excerpts as full-track certification. The minimal 60-second excerpt and two independent recordings per rate prevent a single short signal from being mislabeled as a corpus.
